name: CanvasTTY Environments
description: Where a card runs: its own git worktree or a server over ssh, and Collect changes to bring the work home as a local branch.
description.ru: Где работает окно: в своём git worktree или на сервере по ssh, и «Collect changes», чтобы забрать работу домой локальной веткой.
author: CanvasTTY contributors

modules.title: Git worktree
modules.description: Runs a card in its own git worktree (a branch in its own folder, in the plugin's data folder); removed on close unless you keep it.

modules.title: SSH server
modules.description: Runs a card on a server you configure (label, ssh alias or host, user, folder mapping) through your own ssh config and agent. No keys are stored.

modules.title: Collect changes
modules.description: Card action and orchestrator tool that bring a worktree or server card's work home as a new local branch; nothing is merged.

services.title: Git worktree
services.description: Creates, reopens and removes git worktrees for cards started in this environment.

environments.label: Git worktree
environments.description: A branch in its own folder; the project folder stays untouched.

services.title: SSH server
services.description: Runs cards on a configured server over ssh; checks the server is reachable before starting and on restore.

environments.label: SSH server
environments.description: Runs on a server from the plugin's settings, in the folder mapped to this project.

services.title: Collect changes
services.description: Brings a worktree or server card's changes home as a local branch.

tools.name: collect
tools.description: Bring the changes of one of your subagents (or your own card) that runs in a worktree or on an ssh server home as a new local branch canvastty/<id>-<title>. Credential files are left out; nothing is merged and the current branch is not touched. Collect each finished subagent, then merge the branches.

sessionId.description: A subagent of yours; omit for your own card.

contributions.title: Servers
contributions.description: Servers and folder mappings for the ssh-host environment.
